text: G48's readings 67 to 72, settled on A16's third restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (67) an objection from a speaker who recruits for another faction in the same post ('join the void and only the void') is not shown as the room's restraint, as reading 11 (diablo c0032, EL-ONE); (68) a call to make an offensive symbol or a slogan that names no other work is not shown as an attack on another room's work (reading 8; dankmemes c0667, h3h3productions c0140), and refusing an off-canvas raid is not restraint toward another room's work on the canvas (dankmemes c0498, c0505); (69) a proposal followed, later in the same post, by 'Please don't do this' shows the order in the post's words (O-H), unlike a call whose words limit its own scope (reading 33) (evex c0031, c0032); (70) where the room's first coded attack call draws no answer and its first restraint answers a later call in another thread, the restraint follows the first attack by the hours only, so the line is O-H (gamindustri c0076 h+50.71, c0131 h+53.90); (71) a member's report of helping make a work that was another room's, answered by that room's telling and the member's 'oops, sorry about that haha', is the room's act and its apology in the thread (gameofthrones c0098, c0101, c0103), as reading 58; (72) a suggestion of friendship that gives no reason ('Or we can just all be friends') is BARE, as reading 51 (funhaus c0179), and so is a dismissal ('Holy shit who gives a fuck', falcons c0003). G48's readings 73 to 78, settled on A16's fourth restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (73) a reply from a helper whose flair names another room (Kymoon, flair Lithuania, in latvia) is a visitor's and not the room's restraint, and a reply that admits the writer's own room stole other flags while asking the room to spare a third is not shown as the room's (knaekce c0027), so latvia-036 shows one end (EL-ONE); (74) replies from the rival's fans telling the room to make its own logo are the target's (reading 11; habs c0243, c0244, c0246 under the room's coded call c0062 h+14.39), and a reply whose side cannot be read ('I'm working with you, you meme') is not shown as the room's restraint (homelab c0039); (75) a member's apology that reports the member's own damage to a neighbour's work ('Oh sorry dude I partly destroyed') shows the act and the apology in one post (reading 9; hunterxhunter, O-H); (76) a call to attack a neighbour that encroaches on the room is defence of its place (readings 22, 49; nVade c0067), and a visitor's apology for changing the room's own work is an attack the room suffers (nerf c0040); both EL-NA; (77) mock disapproval that asks how to help ('Seems immature as fuck. How can I help?') is not restraint (liverpoolfc, EL-ONE), nor is a tactic change that keeps the attack (orderofthebluecorner c0023, reading 29); a refusal because the writer is busy elsewhere is a refusal with a reason (katawashoujo c0018); a participant who joins the room's effort and asks it to spare the participant's other room is the room's restraint ('I'm one of them haha. But I'm in!', portal c0083), unlike a target member who does not join (reading 62); (78) where the first attack call draws no restraint and the first restraint answers a later call or a neighbour's telling in another thread, the line is O-H (reading 70; norway c0001 h+4.45 and c0037 h+42.12; orderofthebluecorner c0022 h+6.40 and c0044 h+24.43). luxembourg c0001 h+22.09 is a coded call above c0002 (R). Next: A16-restrict-spec-4.txt
